records.deidentified_narrative: hit and runthe basic story of the accident is that unit 1 was traveling east in the parking lot of mcdonald's (1201 fm 407) when pedestrian was in the parking lot. unit 1 collided lp-0 to pedestrian causing pedestrian to fall down and scrape his right elbow and right knee. unit 1 left the scene. officer shelton was dispatched to 1201 fm 407 (mcdonald's) to speak with the grandmother of a child hit by a vehicle in the parking lot. the call notes indicate the child was not injured. officer shelton arrived and began speaking to flor carcamo who is the child's grandmother. officer shelton quickly found that flor was not at the location when the accident happened. also at the location was the child's uncle, alcione carcamo. alcione was at the location when the incident occurred. alcione said he did not actually see the accident. however, alcione said the vehicle was a maroon ford focus. the driver was a white or hispanic female, 502, 180, brown hair pulled up in a bun. alcione said he believes the person is mcdonald's employee. alcione said the lady got out of the car and said ""did you hit my car?"" alcione said the lady then got back in her car and left the location. she drove off at a normal pace, not like she was trying to flee the scene. alcione said a man in a white truck took off after the suspect vehicle, but he never came back. officer shelton asked the child what happened. the child said the suspect was parked in a parking space and hit him with the left side of the car. the child could not say if the car was parked facing into the parking space or backed in. alcione then said the child's father, valentine garcia ([phone]) saw what happened. alcione said the child's dad went to work at jin be. alcione called him and officer shelton spoke with him. garcia said the lady was traveling through the parking lot from west to east when his son was hit. garcia did not know anything else. after the interviewing it is believed that no adult saw the accident. officer shelton spoke to the manager who said the store manager, martin alvalez ([phone]) could get the video. alcione was under the impression that there are video cameras on that side of the parking lot. the manager said there are no cameras on that side of the store. officer shelton asked the manager if any employees drove a maroon ford focus. she said there was and that it was another manager named victoria aviles. the manager said aviles is the same height, weight and hair color as the suspect. the manager said she is about 50 years old. the manager said aviles worked today, but she left at 1430. the manager did not want to give officer shelton any of this information. at the end of the on scene investigation it is believed that no adult witnessed the accident and there are no cameras on the side of the mcdonald's that accident happened on. aviles is the only lead in the case.

records.public_safe_text: on friday [date] at approximately 1502 hours, i officer clackler #4324, working as [identifier], wearing full police uniform and driving marked patrol vehicle 128-0072, was dispatched to a investigation call located at 4325 [roadway]. upon arrival i spoke with ussery, matthew w/m [date] (vic); who said he was walking from the parking lot to the pizza hut located at [roadway]. while walking across the roadway between the parking lot and the business front, he was on his cell phone texting his wife and was not paying attention; matthew said suddenly a dark grey volkswagen jetta drove right in front of him in the roadway. he said the vehicle ran over his right foot causing pain. matthew confronted the unknown male black driver in the napoli’s pizza shop about it, but he denied running over his foot. the driver left the scene. matthew was not able to get a license plate but instead he got a picture of the rear of vehicle. i went to napoli’s pizza to see if anyone witnessed the incident or if they had cameras. one of the managers, mashriqi, anisa w/f [date] (wit) said the two men came inside and were arguing so she asked them to leave. but she said they do not have cameras. sgt chau made the scene per matthews’s request. i observed swelling on matthews’s right ankle/foot. pictures were taken and uploaded to evidence. com. there was zero suspect info. no cssusgt leach
records.redacted_narrative: on friday [date] at approximately 1502 hours, i officer clackler #4324, working as [identifier], wearing full police uniform and driving marked patrol vehicle 128-0072, was dispatched to a investigation call located at 4325 [roadway]. upon arrival i spoke with ussery, matthew w/m [date] (vic); who said he was walking from the parking lot to the pizza hut located at [roadway]. while walking across the roadway between the parking lot and the business front, he was on his cell phone texting his wife and was not paying attention; matthew said suddenly a dark grey volkswagen jetta drove right in front of him in the roadway. he said the vehicle ran over his right foot causing pain. matthew confronted the unknown male black driver in the napoli’s pizza shop about it, but he denied running over his foot. the driver left the scene. matthew was not able to get a license plate but instead he got a picture of the rear of vehicle. i went to napoli’s pizza to see if anyone witnessed the incident or if they had cameras. one of the managers, mashriqi, anisa w/f [date] (wit) said the two men came inside and were arguing so she asked them to leave. but she said they do not have cameras. sgt chau made the scene per matthews’s request. i observed swelling on matthews’s right ankle/foot. pictures were taken and uploaded to evidence. com. there was zero suspect info. no cssusgt leach
